fear.label: Fear day: Fri Oct 23
fear.text: Fri Oct 23: SPY and YOU both closed red, the kind of day the desk's fear-day rule buys.

why: the weekly chart is in its declining stage

plan.sentence: Buy only after a daily close above +0.8% from the Oct 23 close, up to +1.6%. Target +6.1%. Once in, out on a daily close below −1.5%.
plan.why_t1: the 1.618 extension of the Oct 22–Oct 23 pullback, past the sellers at the Apr 2 low

YUM.gist: A falling stock; the buy comes only when it clears the Sep 12, 2025 high.

standouts.head: A runaway gap up
standouts.text: On Oct 15 it gapped up with the trend and has not looked back (+1.7% at the open).
standouts.learn: A gap in the middle of a trend, with it: the move is accelerating.

standouts.head: Sitting on stacked support
standouts.text: Price sits on the Jan 5 low, the most-traded price of six months and the 61.8% retracement of the Aug 24–Sep 18 drop, where 5 levels of 3 kinds meet.
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

standouts.head: Accumulation
standouts.text: In five weeks it had 5 up days and 2 down days on volume above both the day before and its average.
standouts.learn: Up days on heavy volume mean institutions are buying; heavy down days (distribution) mean they are selling.

standouts.head: MACD positive
standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram falling.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; crossing above its signal line means momentum is turning up.

against.head: Weekly chart: declining
against.text: On the weekly chart price is below a falling 30-week average: the declining stage.
against.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; the advancing stage (above a rising 30-week average) is where longs pay.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: A swing high under the one before and a swing low under the one before: the steps of a downtrend.

against.head: Bounce in a downtrend
against.text: Price has bounced above its 50-day average but stays under the falling 200-day, with the 50-day below the 200-day.
against.learn: A rise inside a downtrend; sellers often return at resistance.

YUM.take: YUM: it is bouncing inside a downtrend; the buy waits for a daily close above the Sep 12, 2025 high, the first sign the decline is over. There is a runaway gap up, and it sits on stacked support. Against it, the weekly chart is in its declining stage. The desk stays out until the trigger's close says otherwise.
YUM.change: Until a daily close above +0.8%, the decline is intact and there is no trade; once in, a daily close below −1.5%, under the Jan 5 low, proves it wrong. The case against, that the weekly chart is in its declining stage, fails on a weekly close above +1.3%, the 30-week average.
